pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions are irregularly polygonal with rounded vertices. Edge transitions exhibit smooth pixel gradients rather than sharp boundaries, indicating a lack of high-frequency angularity at this resolution. The relative spatial area of the patches is significantly greater than that of the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous, interconnected network of pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform throughout the mid-flank area, though boundaries are soft due to image blur.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a continuous, low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.
